method: All selected current-license empty format-review checkpoints are audited. Only sources whose cached UTF-8 bytes match original response checksums and whose organization identity re-validates are emitted. Each person retains a single source row: explicit disciplines outrank teaching-position subjects, which outrank unpublished subjects. Subjects from different pages are never unioned under one source hash. Original checkedAt times and source hashes are retained; this is a cache re-read, not a fresh fetch.
